claims.statement: A contract with a customer exists under ASC 606-10-25-1: the arrangement is approved, identifies each party's rights and payment terms, has commercial substance, and collection is probable.

The contract contains three promised goods and services: hosted SaaS subscription, implementation services, and premium support. The SaaS subscription and premium support are distinct. Whether implementation services are distinct from the SaaS subscription requires professional judgment.
claims.conclusion: Three performance obligations, subject to review of the implementation-services distinctness judgment.

claims.statement: The transaction price is 300,000 USD. There is no variable consideration, significant financing component, noncash consideration, or consideration payable to the customer identified in the demo arrangement.

The transaction price is allocated to the performance obligations on a relative standalone selling price basis: 192,000 USD to the SaaS subscription, 60,000 USD to implementation services, and 48,000 USD to premium support.
claims.conclusion: Allocation ties to the relative SSP calculation and sums to the transaction price.

claims.statement: Revenue allocated to the SaaS subscription and premium support is recognized ratably over the 24-month term. Revenue allocated to implementation services is recognized at completion of implementation, expected 2026-03-31, subject to the distinctness judgment.
claims.conclusion: Draft recognition pattern per the revenue schedule; pending judgment review.
